name: Forsaken Aid
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Magatha Grimtotem seeks Forsaken Aid for the blighted spirits of Stonetalon. She turns to Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision, hoping tauren and undead knowledge can help the suffering land.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Partnership
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem sees practical value in the Forsaken alliance. Word reaches Thunder Bluff of corrupted elemental spirits and suffering land in the Stonetalon Mountains, so she turns to the undead for help. She believes those who understand disease may help cure it. Rather than seek traditional druidic remedies, she sends you to the Royal Apothecary Society.

sections.title: Beneath the Spirit Rise
sections.body: Apothecary Zamah represents Undercity interests on Kalimdor from the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise. Tauren shamans, priests, and seers use the cavern as a sacred retreat. Zamah's presence brings Forsaken work into their midst. Magatha sends a serpent messenger ahead of you to alert Zamah, opening a direct line to the Forsaken's alchemical researchers.

faq.q: Why is Magatha Grimtotem consulting the Forsaken about Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Magatha believes the Forsaken's knowledge of plagues and disease can help diagnose and treat the sickness in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Where can Apothecary Zamah be found?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zamah lives in the Pools of Vision, an underground cavern beneath Spirit Rise on Thunder Bluff's northwestern bluff. A cave tunnel near the pool on the mesa above leads inside.

faq.q: What happens when you accept the quest from Magatha?
faq.answer: When you accept Magatha's request, she summons a Serpent Messenger. It slithers and flies across Thunder Bluff toward Apothecary Zamah to announce your arrival.

faq.q: How do the Forsaken feel about helping the tauren in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zamah expresses sympathy for Stonetalon's troubled spirits. She says the Forsaken are eager to help and strengthen their bond with the Horde.

faq.q: What quest line follows after speaking with Zamah?
faq.answer: After you meet Zamah, the investigation turns to Forsaken alchemy and eventually leads to Journey to Tarren Mill in the Eastern Kingdoms. There, you consult higher-ranking apothecaries.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken stationed inside the sacred Pools of Vision?
aliases: why are undead in pools of vision
faq.answer: The Pools of Vision host Horde scholars, mages, and seers. Apothecary Zamah works there as an official emissary and researcher, keeping her controversial experiments away from the main thoroughfares.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may look to druidism and the Earth Mother to heal the land. Magatha's turn to undead alchemists shows her unconventional approach to tribal diplomacy.
As Forsaken, you can offer alchemical aid to the tauren and prove your worth. It is a chance to earn trust within a wary Horde.
As Horde, you share an alliance shaped since the Third War, linking Kalimdor and Lordaeron.
